item.title: Sugar industry faces devastating crisis: Tongaat Hulett heads for liquidation as Vision Deal collapses
item.description: Tongaat Hulett Limited’s business rescue practitioners have applied to the High Court of South Africa for provisional liquidation following the collapse of acquisition talks with the Vision consortium, a development that industry representatives warn could devastate the country’s entire sugar sector.

item.title: FMD | The officials allegedly behind revoked vaccine deal
item.description: A private South African veterinary vaccine company, recently awarded the sole agency to import and distribute an Argentine vaccine against foot-and-mouth disease, has broken its silence after the agreement was unexpectedly terminated.

item.title: Excellent sheep at Bergplaas Merino’s production auction
item.description: Stephan Nel and his son, Stephan junior, of the Bergplaas Merino stud once again ensured that buyers could walk away with excellent animals at their annual production auction, held on 20 January on the family farm Prospect, near Barkly East.

item.title: SAHPRA fast-tracks critical FMD vaccines to protect livestock
item.description: The South African Health Products Regulatory Authority (SAHPRA) has granted Section 21 authorisation for the emergency importation of Dollvet foot-and-mouth disease vaccines, marking a crucial step in protecting the country’s livestock industry from the highly contagious viral outbreak.

item.title: Business advice from livestock farmer Thabo Dithakgwe
item.description: Thabo Dithakgwe farms cattle, goats and sheep on the 2,500-hectare Ottawa Farm near Tosca in North West. He named his business Nasi Ditha Farming, Wildlife and Projects, after his grandfather, who played an instrumental role in his journey to becoming a farmer. Thabo was only 14 when he began farming part time with his dad and uncle in Pomfret, near Morokweng, on land granted to the Barolong Boo Maiketso Communal Property Association in 2015.

item.title: Land Bank appoints Jabu Mphambo as acting CEO
item.description: Following the resignation announcement of Land and Agricultural Development Bank of South Africa(Land Bank) Chief Executive Officer Themba Rikhotso on 9 February, the Board of Directors has moved swiftly to ensure stability.

item.title: FMD | Lactalis SA backs producers amid new outbreaks
item.description: Lactalis South Africa will continue to collect milk from producers regardless of their foot-and-mouth disease status, the company has said in a letter to its producers in response to recent outbreaks of the disease in the Western Cape.

item.title: NSPCA welcomes conviction in Dealesville pig neglect case
item.description: The National Council of SPCAs (NSPCA)has welcomed the guilty verdict and sentencing in a harrowing animal cruelty case involving the severe neglect of pigs in Dealesville in the Free State.
